svg.text: Direct stick test - layout of the 10-stick arrow (design B, barbed head)
The test needs only the 10 sticks connected; they do not have to be fixed in this shape.
about 31 cm wide, 9 cm high (the exact size depends on the gaps)
Blue dot = data-in end (LED 1) of the stick. Each stick: 80 x 10 x 10 mm, 10 LEDs.
Wings are at 30 degrees: with 80 mm sticks the wing spans 69 mm along the shaft and 40 mm across it.
Stick 11 A3 spare, not part of the arrow: the Grove Base Shield for the Mega has 11 connectors with a data pin,
so this test also drives an 11th stick if you have one (set ACTIVE_STICKS in sketch.ino).
